image: ../../assets/images/avatar.jpg
comments: false

# Enable listing feature to automatically fetch articles from the corresponding directory and arrange them into lists
listing:
  # --- First list: Blog posts ---
  - id: blog-listings          # Give it a name, called blog-listings
    contents: blog  # Fetch content from here
    sort: "date desc"          # Sort by date in descending order
    type: default              # Default list style, another option is type: grid for grid style
    max-items: 3
    fields: [date, title, description, categories]
    filter-ui: false
    sort-ui: false

  # --- Second list: Notes list ---
  - id: notes-listings       # Give it a name, called notes-listings
    contents: notes
    sort: "date desc"  # Sort by date in descending order
    type: default
    max-items: 3

about:
  template: trestles
  image-width: 10em
  image-shape: rounded
  id: hero-heading
  links:

      text: GitHub
      href: https://github.com/perryopytixz
    - icon: envelope
      text: Email
      href: "mailto:your-email@example.com"
    - icon: google
      text: Google Scholar
      href: https://scholar.google.com/


# Hide chapter numbers on the homepage
number-sections: false
